_: The answer sheet for this page state, read by the scripted leaf
It is the operator saying 'on this page state, these are the answers' —
which is exactly the judgement a model makes at runtime and a script
cannot. It belongs to the page, not to the code, which is why it lives
beside the page it answers for. A model run ignores it entirely.
The IGT half keys on the panel's own question id, never on the step
number: one step number spans several screens and inapplicable steps
never render. The manual half names the findings a reviewer would file
on this page, each with the leaf id from the skill file it belongs to.
